**sdd/issue-887-lane-collector/spec**

**What**: Wrote openspec/changes/issue-887-lane-collector/spec.md — the delta spec for the #887 lane collector, refining archive/862/spec.md's "collector uses plumbing with deterministic dedup (C2)" requirement into 9 testable requirements: candidate selection (D5), deterministic dedup on divergence (D3/C2), scrub-before-hash (D4), lane ref first-run/append (D2), no-mutation invariant (D6), ambient author identity (D6), collect op output/dispatch (D1), scope boundary (D7). Each requirement has GIVEN/WHEN/THEN scenarios; a STRICT TDD test map cross-references lane/plan.test.mjs (pure), lane/collect.integration.test.mjs (real temp-repo two-worktree integration), and cli.collect.test.mjs (op-level, following the repo's cli.<op>.test.mjs convention).
**Why**: sdd-spec phase for #887, per the ratified ruling (sdd/issue-887-lane-collector/ruling, D1-D7 as recommended in proposal.md).
**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-887-lane-collector/spec.md (worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-887). Shape modeled on openspec/changes/issue-886-mr-auto-merge/spec.md (sibling code slice), not archive/886 (886 is not yet archived — it lives at issue-886-mr-auto-merge).
**Learned**: The launch prompt referenced "openspec/changes/archive/886/spec.md" as the shape reference, but #886 has not been archived yet — the correct path is openspec/changes/issue-886-mr-auto-merge/spec.md. Followed that file's exact shape: Requirement headers tagged with D-refs, `#### Scenario:` blocks with plain (non-bold) GIVEN/WHEN/THEN/AND bullets, a "STRICT TDD test map" table (not narrative), and a trailing "Non-goals" section. Test file naming for the CLI op follows the existing repo convention `cli.<op>.test.mjs` (e.g. cli.audit.test.mjs, cli.migrate-v1.test.mjs) rather than a generic "cli.*.test.mjs" placeholder.
